title: Foxglove Fund II — Meridian allocation discussion
body:
Dear Dana,

Thank you again for the Fund II materials you sent through after our call in March. Tom and I have now taken the deck and the DDQ pack through a first internal read, and I'm pleased to say the response has been positive. We would like to move this to a formal recommendation.

A few points before we do:

1. Allocation size. We are currently modelling a commitment of £8m to Foxglove Fund II. Our investment committee chair, Alistair Penhale, has asked whether the fund would be open to a slightly larger ticket (£10m) if we can aggregate two client mandates — and, conversely, whether £8m keeps us above the threshold for the LPAC seat we discussed.

2. Track record verification. Alistair will want at least two references before the committee meets in May: ideally one co-investor who has worked alongside you on a Fund I deal, and one portfolio founder. Could you propose names?

3. Data room. Tom flagged that the Fund I quarterly reports in the data room stop at Q3 2025. Could the Q4 pack be added? If it's easier, point us to whoever runs fund operations on your side and Tom can liaise directly.

We would also like to table a short side letter — nothing exotic, mostly reporting cadence and an MFN clause — which Tom will set out separately once you confirm you're open to it.

Our IC meets on 14 May, so anything you can get to us by end of April would be very helpful.

Best regards,
Priya

Priya Nair
Director, Private Markets
Meridian Wealth
priya.nair@meridianwealth.co.uk | +44 20 7946 0311

title: Re: Foxglove Fund II — Meridian allocation discussion
body:
Priya, Tom —

This is great news. Taking your points in order:

1. Allocation. We would be delighted with either number. At £10m aggregated you would be our second-largest LP in Fund II and I'd be happy to formalise the LPAC seat; at £8m you are still comfortably above our £5m LPAC threshold, so the seat is yours either way. Please tell Alistair Penhale the seat is not contingent on stretching to £10m — I'd rather have the right size for your clients than an uncomfortable one.

2. References. Two names for you: Sam Okafor at Halcyon Capital co-invested with us on three Fund I deals and will speak candidly about how we behave in tense rounds. On the founder side, I'd suggest Noor Haddad, CEO of Quillwork Bio — we led her seed and Series A, and she's been through both good news and bad with us. I'll make warm intros as soon as you confirm.

3. Data room. Apologies — the Q4 2025 pack should have been in there. Our head of fund operations, Ines Delacroix (ines@foxglove.vc), is uploading it today along with the audited Fund I financials. Tom, please treat Ines as your direct contact for anything data-room or reporting related; she is far faster than I am.

4. Side letter. Open in principle. Reporting cadence and MFN are both standard for us. Send Tom's list over and we'll turn it around with counsel.

Speak soon,
Dana

Dana Whitfield
Partner, Foxglove Capital
dana@foxglove.vc

title: Re: Foxglove Fund II — Meridian allocation discussion (side letter)
body:
Dana,

Following up on Priya's note with our side letter requests. Ines Delacroix has been extremely helpful on the data room — Q4 pack and audited financials received with a full reconciliation, please pass on our thanks.

Our asks, in rough order of importance to the committee:

- MFN. Standard most-favoured-nations clause, carving out commitments above ours and strategic/anchor arrangements agreed before first close.
- Reporting. Quarterly capital account statements within 45 days of quarter end, and annual audited financials within 120 days. Alistair Penhale has also asked for a short annual ESG summary at portfolio level — a one-pager is fine, nothing audited.
- Co-investment. Priority notification on co-invest opportunities above $2m, no fee / no carry, alongside the fund's other LPAC members.
- Transfer. Pre-approved transfers between Meridian-managed vehicles without GP consent (subject to standard conditions).
- Excuse rights. Standard regulatory excuse language given our FCA-regulated client base.

One process note: our compliance officer, Gemma Trask, will need to run KYC on the GP entity and each of the Fund II carry vehicles before we can sign — could Ines send the structure chart and formation documents directly to her? I'll connect them.

We've scheduled the reference call with Sam Okafor for 29 April; Priya is speaking with Noor Haddad the following week. If both go as expected, this goes to the IC on 14 May as planned.

Best,
Tom

Tom Voss
Associate Director, Private Markets
Meridian Wealth

title: Re: Foxglove Fund II — Meridian allocation discussion (side letter)
body:
Tom, Priya —

We've been through the list with our counsel — Elena Ruiz at Bright & Field is papering the side letter — and here is where we've landed:

- MFN: agreed, with the carve-outs as you framed them.
- Reporting: agreed on 45/120 days. On ESG, we'll commit to an annual portfolio-level summary; Ines Delacroix already produces something close to this for our Nordic LPs, so it's no extra lift.
- Co-investment: agreed on priority notification above $2m, no fee / no carry. One nuance — where a deal is syndicated jointly with another fund (as several Fund I co-invests were with Halcyon), allocation among notified LPs is at GP discretion. Elena will draft language.
- Transfers: agreed for Meridian-managed vehicles, subject to the transferee making standard reps.
- Excuse rights: agreed, standard FCA language.

So: everything, essentially. Elena expects to have a draft to you by Friday. Ines has sent the structure chart and formation docs to Gemma Trask this morning and will handle any KYC follow-ups directly.

Separately — I heard the call with Sam Okafor ran well over the hour, which I choose to take as a good sign. Sam is not someone who pads a reference. And Noor mentioned she enjoyed the conversation with Priya; she's midway through a difficult scale-up year, so you'll have gotten an unvarnished view, which is what you wanted.

Fingers crossed for the 14th. If Alistair or any other committee member wants a direct session with me before then, I'll make the time on short notice.

Best,
Dana

Dana Whitfield
Partner, Foxglove Capital
dana@foxglove.vc

title: Re: Foxglove Fund II — Meridian allocation discussion — IC approved
body:
Dear Dana,

I'm very pleased to confirm that our investment committee approved an £8m commitment to Foxglove Fund II at Thursday's meeting. Alistair Penhale asked me to pass on that the reference calls were decisive — the conversation with Sam Okafor in particular gave the committee real comfort about how Foxglove behaves when a round gets contested, and Noor Haddad's account of the 2025 bridge at Quillwork Bio was, in Alistair's words, "the most honest founder reference I've heard in a decade."

We settled on £8m rather than the aggregated £10m: the second client mandate isn't ready in time for first close, and the committee preferred not to hold up the commitment. We may revisit a top-up at a later close if the fund remains open — no promises sought or given.

Next steps from our side:

- The signed side letter is with Tom; the Friday draft from Elena Ruiz was clean and we accepted it without changes.
- Gemma Trask has completed KYC on the GP and carry vehicles — thanks to Ines Delacroix for turning the follow-ups around within a day, twice.
- We're ready to countersign the subscription documents. Could Ines send execution versions and wire instructions to Tom? We'd like to fund the first drawdown from our June liquidity window if the timing suits.

On a personal note: this has been one of the smoother processes we've run, and that is a credit to how your team communicates. We're glad to be partners in Fund II, and I look forward to taking up the LPAC seat.

Warm regards,
Priya

Priya Nair

Meridian Wealth
